rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday adjective for a physically attractive person of any gender.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this specifically when describing a good-looking male, especially in casual speech.

example.english: That new colleague is pretty good-looking.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 san1 tung4 si6 gei2 leng3 zai2 wo3
